limitations: The combined map supports scheme comparison and spatial coordination; it is not survey-controlled and must not be used for setting out, construction or acceptance.
LTA Road Section Line supplies horizontal geometry. Road names, widths and bridge/tunnel attributes are supplemented from nearest-match OSM records and are not surveyed attributes.
The complete road network is shown to preserve connectivity; private and construction attributes require engineering interpretation.
The Rhu Cross A-B dashed orange connector is a user-approved scheme placeholder without LTA kerb evidence, not an existing road or surveyed alignment.
P0 building heights are estimated when OSM height and building:levels are absent and are scaled for display.
P0 terrain and bridge elevations are display-grade and must not be used for engineering elevation analysis.
Generated land blocks are visual faces, not cadastral parcels.
Building relations and complex shoreline relations require full-city pipeline hardening.
